aetherium.vulkan.switch.title: Aetherium needs Vulkan
aetherium.vulkan.switch.message: The game is running on OpenGL, so shader packs and Aetherium's GPU features are off. Switch the Graphics API to Vulkan and quit? It takes effect the next time you start the game.
aetherium.vulkan.failed.title: Vulkan could not start
aetherium.vulkan.failed.message: The Graphics API is set to Vulkan, but it could not start on this PC, so the game fell back to OpenGL. Shader packs and Aetherium's GPU features are off. Updating the graphics driver usually fixes this.
